name: Castle Guard
title: The King's Steel
examine: Steel from crown to heel, polished past argument. The Line's livery makes the wearer look permanent.
lines: The hall is open when the banners are out. The Crown likes to be seen. We like the Crown to be seen from a respectful distance.
Third watch on the forecourt. The view's the pay, and up here the view pays well.
The King greets travelers who've earned the climb. The Queen remembers their names after. Between the two of them nothing gets past this door.
